title: Recent Advances in Natural Language Inference: A Survey of Benchmarks, Resources, and Approaches

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying evaluation benchmarks like Winogender and Event2Mind to assess model vulnerabilities to gender-biased training data, specifically through coreference resolution tasks involving occupational pronouns.

Analyzing superficial correlation biases, label distribution biases, and stylistic annotation artifacts in NLI benchmark datasets using baseline model exploitation and mutual information calculations.
